## CRATE FILE: crates/blender-mcp-ipc/src/lib.rs

use std::fs::OpenOptions;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::time::{Duration, SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};
use memmap2::MmapMut;
use thiserror::Error;
use tokio::io::{AsyncReadExt, AsyncWriteExt};
use tokio::net::TcpStream;

#[derive(Error, Debug)]
pub enum IpcError {
    #[error("IO error: {0}")]
    Io(#[from] std::io::Error),

    #[error("Serialization error: {0}")]
    Serialization(#[from] serde_json::Error),

    #[error("Timeout waiting for Blender response")]
    Timeout,

    #[error("Protocol error: {0}")]
    Protocol(String),

    #[error("Shared memory buffer overflow: capacity {capacity} bytes, requested {requested} bytes")]
    BufferOverflow { capacity: usize, requested: usize },

    #[error("Invalid frame header magic (expected 0x4652414D, got 0x{0:08X})")]
    InvalidMagic(u32),
}

/// Control transport client communicating with the Blender addon instance.
pub struct BlenderIpcClient {
    host: String,
    port: u16,
    timeout: Duration,
}

impl BlenderIpcClient {
    pub fn new(host: impl Into<String>, port: u16) -> Self {
        Self {
            host: host.into(),
            port,
            timeout: Duration::from_secs(30),
        }
    }

    pub fn with_timeout(mut self, timeout: Duration) -> Self {
        self.timeout = timeout;
        self
    }

    pub async fn send_command(&self, command: &serde_json::Value) -> Result<serde_json::Value, IpcError> {
        let addr = format!("{}:{}", self.host, self.port);
        let mut stream = tokio::time::timeout(self.timeout, TcpStream::connect(&addr))
            .await
            .map_err(|_| IpcError::Timeout)??;

        let payload = serde_json::to_vec(command)?;
        stream.write_all(&payload).await?;
        stream.write_all(b"\n").await?;
        stream.flush().await?;

        let mut buffer = Vec::new();
        let mut chunk = [0u8; 8192];

        loop {
            let bytes_read = tokio::time::timeout(self.timeout, stream.read(&mut chunk))
                .await
                .map_err(|_| IpcError::Timeout)??;

            if bytes_read == 0 {
                break;
            }
            buffer.extend_from_slice(&chunk[..bytes_read]);

            // Attempt to parse complete JSON
            if let Ok(val) = serde_json::from_slice::<serde_json::Value>(&buffer) {
                return Ok(val);
            }
        }

        if buffer.is_empty() {
            return Err(IpcError::Protocol("Empty response from Blender".to_string()));
        }

        let resp: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_slice(&buffer)?;
        Ok(resp)
    }
}

pub const SHM_MAGIC: u32 = 0x4652414D; // 'FRAM' in ASCII

#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
pub struct FrameHeader {
    pub magic: u32,
    pub sequence: u64,
    pub width: u32,
    pub height: u32,
    pub channels: u32,
    pub timestamp_ns: u64,
    pub data_size: u64,
}

pub const HEADER_SIZE: usize = std::mem::size_of::<FrameHeader>();

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct FrameSnapshot {
    pub sequence: u64,
    pub width: u32,
    pub height: u32,
    pub channels: u32,
    pub timestamp_ns: u64,
    pub pixels: Vec<u8>,
}

/// Shared memory ring buffer for zero-copy viewport framebuffer streaming.
pub struct SharedMemoryViewport {
    path: PathBuf,
    mmap: MmapMut,
    sequence: u64,
}

impl SharedMemoryViewport {
    pub fn create_or_open(path: impl AsRef<Path>, capacity: usize) -> Result<Self, IpcError> {
        let path_buf = path.as_ref().to_path_buf();
        if let Some(parent) = path_buf.parent() {
            std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;
        }

        let file = OpenOptions::new()
            .read(true)
            .write(true)
            .create(true)
            .truncate(false)
            .open(&path_buf)?;

        let current_len = file.metadata()?.len() as usize;
        if current_len < capacity {
            file.set_len(capacity as u64)?;
        }

        let mmap = unsafe { MmapMut::map_mut(&file)? };

        Ok(Self {
            path: path_buf,
            mmap,
            sequence: 0,
        })
    }

    pub fn path(&self) -> &Path {
        &self.path
    }

    pub fn write_frame(
        &mut self,
        width: u32,
        height: u32,
        channels: u32,
        data: &[u8],
    ) -> Result<(), IpcError> {
        let total_required = HEADER_SIZE + data.len();
        if total_required > self.mmap.len() {
            return Err(IpcError::BufferOverflow {
                capacity: self.mmap.len(),
                requested: total_required,
            });
        }

        self.sequence += 1;
        let timestamp_ns = SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
            .unwrap_or_default()
            .as_nanos() as u64;

        let header = FrameHeader {
            magic: SHM_MAGIC,
            sequence: self.sequence,
            width,
            height,
            channels,
            timestamp_ns,
            data_size: data.len() as u64,
        };

        unsafe {
            let header_ptr = self.mmap.as_mut_ptr() as *mut FrameHeader;
            std::ptr::write_unaligned(header_ptr, header);
        }

        self.mmap[HEADER_SIZE..HEADER_SIZE + data.len()].copy_from_slice(data);
        self.mmap.flush()?;

        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn read_latest_frame(&self) -> Result<Option<FrameSnapshot>, IpcError> {
        if self.mmap.len() < HEADER_SIZE {
            return Ok(None);
        }

        let header = unsafe {
            let header_ptr = self.mmap.as_ptr() as *const FrameHeader;
            std::ptr::read_unaligned(header_ptr)
        };

        if header.magic == 0 {
            return Ok(None);
        }

        if header.magic != SHM_MAGIC {
            return Err(IpcError::InvalidMagic(header.magic));
        }

        let data_size = header.data_size as usize;
        let end = HEADER_SIZE + data_size;
        if end > self.mmap.len() {
            return Err(IpcError::BufferOverflow {
                capacity: self.mmap.len(),
                requested: end,
            });
        }

        let pixels = self.mmap[HEADER_SIZE..end].to_vec();

        Ok(Some(FrameSnapshot {
            sequence: header.sequence,
            width: header.width,
            height: header.height,
            channels: header.channels,
            timestamp_ns: header.timestamp_ns,
            pixels,
        }))
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_shared_memory_viewport_roundtrip() {
        let temp_dir = std::env::temp_dir();
        let shm_path = temp_dir.join("test_viewport.shm");

        let mut viewport = SharedMemoryViewport::create_or_open(&shm_path, 1024 * 1024)
            .expect("Failed to create shm viewport");

        let fake_pixels = vec![128u8; 100 * 100 * 4];
        viewport
            .write_frame(100, 100, 4, &fake_pixels)
            .expect("Failed to write frame");

        let snapshot = viewport
            .read_latest_frame()
            .expect("Failed to read frame")
            .expect("Expected frame snapshot");

        assert_eq!(snapshot.sequence, 1);
        assert_eq!(snapshot.width, 100);
        assert_eq!(snapshot.height, 100);
        assert_eq!(snapshot.channels, 4);
        assert_eq!(snapshot.pixels.len(), 100 * 100 * 4);
        assert_eq!(snapshot.pixels[0], 128);

        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(shm_path);
    }
}

## CRATE FILE: crates/blender-mcp-pbr/src/lib.rs

use std::path::Path;
use image::{GrayImage, ImageBuffer, Rgba, RgbaImage};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Error, Debug)]
pub enum PbrError {
    #[error("Image IO or format error: {0}")]
    Image(#[from] image::ImageError),

    #[error("Dimension mismatch between channels: {0}")]
    DimensionMismatch(String),

    #[error("IO error: {0}")]
    Io(#[from] std::io::Error),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct OrmPackResult {
    pub width: u32,
    pub height: u32,
    pub output_path: String,
}

/// Packs separate Ambient Occlusion (R), Roughness (G), and Metallic (B) maps into a single ORM texture.
/// Missing channels are filled with game-standard PBR defaults:
/// - AO: 255 (1.0, fully unoccluded)
/// - Roughness: 128 (0.5, balanced roughness)
/// - Metallic: 0 (0.0, non-metallic/dielectric)
pub fn pack_orm(
    ao_path: Option<impl AsRef<Path>>,
    roughness_path: Option<impl AsRef<Path>>,
    metallic_path: Option<impl AsRef<Path>>,
    output_path: impl AsRef<Path>,
) -> Result<OrmPackResult, PbrError> {
    let load_gray = |opt: Option<&Path>| -> Result<Option<GrayImage>, PbrError> {
        match opt {
            Some(p) if p.exists() => {
                let img = image::open(p)?;
                Ok(Some(img.to_luma8()))
            }
            _ => Ok(None),
        }
    };

    let ao_p = ao_path.as_ref().map(|p| p.as_ref());
    let rough_p = roughness_path.as_ref().map(|p| p.as_ref());
    let metal_p = metallic_path.as_ref().map(|p| p.as_ref());

    let ao_img = load_gray(ao_p)?;
    let rough_img = load_gray(rough_p)?;
    let metal_img = load_gray(metal_p)?;

    let (width, height) = match (&ao_img, &rough_img, &metal_img) {
        (Some(img), _, _) => img.dimensions(),
        (_, Some(img), _) => img.dimensions(),
        (_, _, Some(img)) => img.dimensions(),
        _ => (1024, 1024),
    };

    let mut orm_buffer: RgbaImage = ImageBuffer::new(width, height);

    for y in 0..height {
        for x in 0..x_limit(width) {
            let r = ao_img.as_ref().map_or(255, |img| img.get_pixel(x, y)[0]);
            let g = rough_img.as_ref().map_or(128, |img| img.get_pixel(x, y)[0]);
            let b = metal_img.as_ref().map_or(0, |img| img.get_pixel(x, y)[0]);
            orm_buffer.put_pixel(x, y, Rgba([r, g, b, 255]));
        }
    }

    let out_ref = output_path.as_ref();
    if let Some(parent) = out_ref.parent() {
        std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;
    }

    orm_buffer.save(out_ref)?;

    Ok(OrmPackResult {
        width,
        height,
        output_path: out_ref.display().to_string(),
    })
}

#[inline(always)]
fn x_limit(w: u32) -> u32 {
    w
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_pack_orm_defaults() {
        let temp_dir = std::env::temp_dir();
        let out_file = temp_dir.join("test_orm_output.png");

        let res = pack_orm(
            None::<&Path>,
            None::<&Path>,
            None::<&Path>,
            &out_file,
        ).expect("Packing failed");

        assert_eq!(res.width, 1024);
        assert_eq!(res.height, 1024);

        let img = image::open(&out_file).expect("Failed to load output image").to_rgba8();
        let px = img.get_pixel(0, 0);
        assert_eq!(px[0], 255); // Default AO
        assert_eq!(px[1], 128); // Default Roughness
        assert_eq!(px[2], 0);   // Default Metallic
        assert_eq!(px[3], 255); // Alpha

        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(out_file);
    }
}

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

pub const LATEST_MCP_VERSION: &str = "2024-11-05";

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
#[serde(untagged)]
pub enum RequestId {
    String(String),
    Number(i64),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct JsonRpcRequest {
    pub jsonrpc: String,
    pub id: RequestId,
    pub method: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub params: Option<serde_json::Value>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct JsonRpcResponse {
    pub jsonrpc: String,
    pub id: RequestId,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub result: Option<serde_json::Value>,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub error: Option<JsonRpcError>,
}

impl JsonRpcResponse {
    pub fn success(id: RequestId, result: serde_json::Value) -> Self {
        Self {
            jsonrpc: "2.0".to_string(),
            id,
            result: Some(result),
            error: None,
        }
    }

    pub fn error(id: RequestId, code: i32, message: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        Self {
            jsonrpc: "2.0".to_string(),
            id,
            result: None,
            error: Some(JsonRpcError {
                code,
                message: message.into(),
                data: None,
            }),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct JsonRpcError {
    pub code: i32,
    pub message: String,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub data: Option<serde_json::Value>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct InitializeResult {
    #[serde(rename = "protocolVersion")]
    pub protocol_version: String,
    pub capabilities: ServerCapabilities,
    #[serde(rename = "serverInfo")]
    pub server_info: Implementation,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]
pub struct ServerCapabilities {
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub tools: Option<ToolsCapability>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]
pub struct ToolsCapability {
    #[serde(rename = "listChanged", skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub list_changed: Option<bool>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Implementation {
    pub name: String,
    pub version: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ContentBlock {
    #[serde(rename = "type")]
    pub content_type: String,
    pub text: String,
}

impl ContentBlock {
    pub fn text(text: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        Self {
            content_type: "text".to_string(),
            text: text.into(),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct CallToolResult {
    pub content: Vec<ContentBlock>,
    #[serde(rename = "isError", skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub is_error: Option<bool>,
}

impl CallToolResult {
    pub fn success(text: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        Self {
            content: vec![ContentBlock::text(text)],
            is_error: None,
        }
    }

    pub fn error(text: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        Self {
            content: vec![ContentBlock::text(text)],
            is_error: Some(true),
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_jsonrpc_request_response_serialization() {
        let req = JsonRpcRequest {
            jsonrpc: "2.0".to_string(),
            id: RequestId::Number(42),
            method: "initialize".to_string(),
            params: None,
        };

        let json = serde_json::to_string(&req).unwrap();
        assert!(json.contains("\"id\":42"));
        assert!(json.contains("\"method\":\"initialize\""));

        let resp = JsonRpcResponse::success(req.id, serde_json::json!({ "status": "ok" }));
        let resp_json = serde_json::to_string(&resp).unwrap();
        assert!(resp_json.contains("\"result\":{\"status\":\"ok\"}"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_call_tool_result_format() {
        let success = CallToolResult::success("Operation completed");
        assert_eq!(success.content.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(success.content[0].text, "Operation completed");
        assert!(success.is_error.is_none());

        let failure = CallToolResult::error("Execution crashed");
        assert_eq!(failure.is_error, Some(true));
    }
}

## CRATE FILE: crates/blender-mcp-reflect/src/lib.rs

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::future::Future;
use std::marker::PhantomData;
use std::sync::Arc;

use async_trait::async_trait;
use schemars::{schema_for, JsonSchema};
use serde::{de::DeserializeOwned, Serialize};
use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Error, Debug)]
pub enum ToolError {
    #[error("Tool '{0}' not found in registry")]
    NotFound(String),

    #[error("Failed to parse tool parameters: {0}")]
    InvalidParameters(#[from] serde_json::Error),

    #[error("Tool execution failed: {0}")]
    ExecutionFailed(String),

    #[error("Internal tool error: {0}")]
    Internal(String),
}

/// Metadata description for an introspectable MCP tool.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct ToolDefinition {
    pub name: String,
    pub description: String,
    pub input_schema: serde_json::Value,
}

/// Trait implemented by introspectable, reflective tools.
#[async_trait]
pub trait ReflectTool: Send + Sync {
    fn name(&self) -> &str;
    fn description(&self) -> &str;
    fn input_schema(&self) -> serde_json::Value;
    async fn execute(&self, params: serde_json::Value) -> Result<serde_json::Value, ToolError>;
}

/// Adapter converting any async function with typed input `P` and output `R` into a reflective MCP tool.
pub struct TypedTool<P, R, F, Fut>
where
    P: JsonSchema + DeserializeOwned + Send + 'static,
    R: Serialize + Send + 'static,
    F: Fn(P) -> Fut + Send + Sync + 'static,
    Fut: Future<Output = Result<R, String>> + Send + 'static,
{
    name: String,
    description: String,
    handler: F,
    _marker: PhantomData<(P, R)>,
}

impl<P, R, F, Fut> TypedTool<P, R, F, Fut>
where
    P: JsonSchema + DeserializeOwned + Send + 'static,
    R: Serialize + Send + 'static,
    F: Fn(P) -> Fut + Send + Sync + 'static,
    Fut: Future<Output = Result<R, String>> + Send + 'static,
{
    pub fn new(name: impl Into<String>, description: impl Into<String>, handler: F) -> Self {
        Self {
            name: name.into(),
            description: description.into(),
            handler,
            _marker: PhantomData,
        }
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl<P, R, F, Fut> ReflectTool for TypedTool<P, R, F, Fut>
where
    P: JsonSchema + DeserializeOwned + Send + Sync + 'static,
    R: Serialize + Send + Sync + 'static,
    F: Fn(P) -> Fut + Send + Sync + 'static,
    Fut: Future<Output = Result<R, String>> + Send + 'static,
{
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        &self.name
    }

    fn description(&self) -> &str {
        &self.description
    }

    fn input_schema(&self) -> serde_json::Value {
        let schema = schema_for!(P);
        serde_json::to_value(schema).unwrap_or(serde_json::json!({
            "type": "object"
        }))
    }

    async fn execute(&self, params: serde_json::Value) -> Result<serde_json::Value, ToolError> {
        let parsed: P = serde_json::from_value(params)?;
        let result = (self.handler)(parsed)
            .await
            .map_err(ToolError::ExecutionFailed)?;
        let serialized = serde_json::to_value(result)?;
        Ok(serialized)
    }
}

/// Central reflective registry managing MCP tools and runtime introspection.
#[derive(Default, Clone)]
pub struct ToolRegistry {
    tools: HashMap<String, Arc<dyn ReflectTool>>,
}

impl ToolRegistry {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            tools: HashMap::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn register(&mut self, tool: impl ReflectTool + 'static) {
        let name = tool.name().to_string();
        self.tools.insert(name, Arc::new(tool));
    }

    pub fn register_arc(&mut self, tool: Arc<dyn ReflectTool>) {
        let name = tool.name().to_string();
        self.tools.insert(name, tool);
    }

    pub fn register_fn<P, R, F, Fut>(
        &mut self,
        name: impl Into<String>,
        description: impl Into<String>,
        handler: F,
    ) where
        P: JsonSchema + DeserializeOwned + Send + Sync + 'static,
        R: Serialize + Send + Sync + 'static,
        F: Fn(P) -> Fut + Send + Sync + 'static,
        Fut: Future<Output = Result<R, String>> + Send + 'static,
    {
        let tool = TypedTool::new(name, description, handler);
        self.register(tool);
    }

    pub fn list_tools(&self) -> Vec<ToolDefinition> {
        self.tools
            .values()
            .map(|t| ToolDefinition {
                name: t.name().to_string(),
                description: t.description().to_string(),
                input_schema: t.input_schema(),
            })
            .collect()
    }

    pub async fn dispatch(
        &self,
        name: &str,
        params: serde_json::Value,
    ) -> Result<serde_json::Value, ToolError> {
        let tool = self
            .tools
            .get(name)
            .ok_or_else(|| ToolError::NotFound(name.to_string()))?;
        tool.execute(params).await
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[derive(serde::Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
    struct AddParams {
        /// The first number
        a: i32,
        /// The second number
        b: i32,
    }

    #[derive(Serialize)]
    struct AddResult {
        sum: i32,
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn test_reflective_tool_registry() {
        let mut registry = ToolRegistry::new();

        registry.register_fn(
            "add_numbers",
            "Adds two integers together",
            |params: AddParams| async move { Ok(AddResult { sum: params.a + params.b }) },
        );

        let tools = registry.list_tools();
        assert_eq!(tools.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(tools[0].name, "add_numbers");
        assert!(tools[0].description.contains("Adds two integers"));

        // Verify JSON schema was generated automatically via reflection
        let schema_obj = tools[0].input_schema.as_object().unwrap();
        assert!(schema_obj.contains_key("properties"));

        // Dispatch call
        let result = registry
            .dispatch("add_numbers", serde_json::json!({ "a": 5, "b": 7 }))
            .await
            .unwrap();

        assert_eq!(result, serde_json::json!({ "sum": 12 }));
    }
}

## CRATE FILE: crates/blender-mcp-synth/src/flora.rs

use std::f32::consts::PI;
use schemars::JsonSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use crate::mesh::ProceduralMesh;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum DesertFloraType {
    Saguaro,
    PricklyPear,
    Yucca,
    DesertRock,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct FloraSynthParams {
    pub flora_type: DesertFloraType,
    #[serde(default = "default_height")]
    pub height: f32,
    #[serde(default = "default_arm_count")]
    pub arm_count: u32,
    #[serde(default = "default_seed")]
    pub seed: u64,
}

fn default_height() -> f32 { 3.5 }
fn default_arm_count() -> u32 { 2 }
fn default_seed() -> u64 { 42 }

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct SynthesizedFlora {
    pub flora_type: DesertFloraType,
    pub mesh: ProceduralMesh,
    pub sockets: Vec<String>,
    pub collider_type: blender_mcp_geom::ColliderType,
}

pub fn synthesize_desert_flora(params: &FloraSynthParams) -> SynthesizedFlora {
    match params.flora_type {
        DesertFloraType::Saguaro => synthesize_saguaro(params),
        DesertFloraType::PricklyPear => synthesize_prickly_pear(params),
        DesertFloraType::Yucca => synthesize_yucca(params),
        DesertFloraType::DesertRock => synthesize_desert_rock(params),
    }
}

fn synthesize_saguaro(params: &FloraSynthParams) -> SynthesizedFlora {
    let mut mesh = ProceduralMesh::new("Desert_Flora_Saguaro", "M_Cactus_Ribbed");
    let ribs = 16;
    let segments = 24;
    let radius = 0.35;
    let height = params.height;

    // Generate fluted cylindrical trunk with vertical ribs
    for s in 0..=segments {
        let v = s as f32 / segments as f32;
        let y = v * height;
        // Natural fluting and taper towards top
        let taper = if v > 0.85 {
            1.0 - (v - 0.85) / 0.15 * 0.4
        } else {
            1.0
        };

        for r in 0..ribs {
            let u = r as f32 / ribs as f32;
            let angle = u * 2.0 * PI;
            // High-frequency fluting along ribs
            let rib_indent = 1.0 + 0.12 * (angle * (ribs as f32 * 0.5)).cos();
            let current_radius = radius * taper * rib_indent;

            let x = angle.cos() * current_radius;
            let z = angle.sin() * current_radius;

            mesh.vertices.push([x, y, z]);
            mesh.normals.push([angle.cos(), 0.0, angle.sin()]);
            mesh.uvs.push([u, v]);
        }
    }

    // Connect quad grid
    for s in 0..segments {
        for r in 0..ribs {
            let next_r = (r + 1) % ribs;
            let idx0 = s * ribs + r;
            let idx1 = s * ribs + next_r;
            let idx2 = (s + 1) * ribs + next_r;
            let idx3 = (s + 1) * ribs + r;

            mesh.indices.push([idx0 as u32, idx1 as u32, idx2 as u32]);
            mesh.indices.push([idx0 as u32, idx2 as u32, idx3 as u32]);
        }
    }

    let mut sockets = vec!["SOCKET_root".to_string(), "SOCKET_crown".to_string()];
    for a in 0..params.arm_count {
        sockets.push(format!("SOCKET_arm_{:02}", a + 1));
    }

    SynthesizedFlora {
        flora_type: DesertFloraType::Saguaro,
        mesh,
        sockets,
        collider_type: blender_mcp_geom::ColliderType::Capsule,
    }
}

fn synthesize_prickly_pear(_params: &FloraSynthParams) -> SynthesizedFlora {
    let mut mesh = ProceduralMesh::new("Desert_Flora_PricklyPear", "M_Cactus_Pad");
    // Generate flattened oval pads
    let segments = 16;
    for i in 0..segments {
        let u = i as f32 / segments as f32;
        let angle = u * 2.0 * PI;
        let x = angle.cos() * 0.4;
        let y = (angle.sin() + 1.0) * 0.5;
        let z = 0.08 * (u * PI).sin();
        mesh.vertices.push([x, y, z]);
        mesh.normals.push([0.0, 0.0, 1.0]);
        mesh.uvs.push([u, 0.5]);
    }

    SynthesizedFlora {
        flora_type: DesertFloraType::PricklyPear,
        mesh,
        sockets: vec!["SOCKET_root".to_string(), "SOCKET_flower".to_string()],
        collider_type: blender_mcp_geom::ColliderType::Convex,
    }
}

fn synthesize_yucca(_params: &FloraSynthParams) -> SynthesizedFlora {
    let mut mesh = ProceduralMesh::new("Desert_Flora_Yucca", "M_Yucca_Blade");
    // Radial rosette of sharp dagger-like leaves
    let blades = 24;
    for b in 0..blades {
        let angle = (b as f32 / blades as f32) * 2.0 * PI;
        let tip_x = angle.cos() * 0.8;
        let tip_y = 0.6;
        let tip_z = angle.sin() * 0.8;

        let base_idx = mesh.vertices.len() as u32;
        mesh.vertices.push([0.0, 0.1, 0.0]);
        mesh.vertices.push([tip_x, tip_y, tip_z]);
        mesh.vertices.push([angle.cos() * 0.05, 0.0, angle.sin() * 0.05]);

        mesh.normals.push([0.0, 1.0, 0.0]);
        mesh.normals.push([angle.cos(), 0.5, angle.sin()]);
        mesh.normals.push([0.0, 1.0, 0.0]);

        mesh.uvs.push([0.0, 0.0]);
        mesh.uvs.push([0.5, 1.0]);
        mesh.uvs.push([1.0, 0.0]);

        mesh.indices.push([base_idx, base_idx + 1, base_idx + 2]);
    }

    SynthesizedFlora {
        flora_type: DesertFloraType::Yucca,
        mesh,
        sockets: vec!["SOCKET_root".to_string(), "SOCKET_flower_stalk".to_string()],
        collider_type: blender_mcp_geom::ColliderType::Convex,
    }
}

fn synthesize_desert_rock(_params: &FloraSynthParams) -> SynthesizedFlora {
    let mut mesh = ProceduralMesh::new("Desert_Rock_Boulder", "M_Desert_Stone");
    // Faceted low-poly weathered rock
    let vertices = vec![
        [-0.6, 0.0, -0.5],
        [0.7, 0.0, -0.4],
        [0.5, 0.0, 0.6],
        [-0.5, 0.0, 0.5],
        [-0.4, 0.8, -0.3],
        [0.4, 0.7, -0.2],
        [0.3, 0.9, 0.4],
        [-0.3, 0.7, 0.3],
    ];

    for v in &vertices {
        mesh.vertices.push(*v);
        mesh.normals.push([v[0], 0.5, v[2]]);
        mesh.uvs.push([v[0] + 0.5, v[2] + 0.5]);
    }

    let indices = vec![
        [0, 1, 5], [0, 5, 4],
        [1, 2, 6], [1, 6, 5],
        [2, 3, 7], [2, 7, 6],
        [3, 0, 4], [3, 4, 7],
        [4, 5, 6], [4, 6, 7],
    ];
    mesh.indices = indices;

    SynthesizedFlora {
        flora_type: DesertFloraType::DesertRock,
        mesh,
        sockets: vec!["SOCKET_ground".to_string()],
        collider_type: blender_mcp_geom::ColliderType::Convex,
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_saguaro_synthesis() {
        let params = FloraSynthParams {
            flora_type: DesertFloraType::Saguaro,
            height: 4.0,
            arm_count: 3,
            seed: 1234,
        };
        let flora = synthesize_desert_flora(&params);
        assert_eq!(flora.flora_type, DesertFloraType::Saguaro);
        assert!(flora.mesh.vertex_count() > 100);
        assert!(flora.mesh.triangle_count() > 100);
        assert_eq!(flora.sockets.len(), 5); // root + crown + 3 arms
        assert_eq!(flora.collider_type, blender_mcp_geom::ColliderType::Capsule);
    }
}

## CRATE FILE: crates/blender-mcp-synth/src/grammar.rs

use schemars::JsonSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct AssemblySocket {
    pub name: String,
    pub position: [f32; 3],
    pub rotation: [f32; 3],
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct AssemblyComponent {
    pub name: String,
    pub component_type: String, // "barrel", "crate", "flora", "mesh"
    pub position: [f32; 3],
    pub scale: [f32; 3],
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct AssemblyGrammar {
    pub root_name: String,
    pub components: Vec<AssemblyComponent>,
    pub sockets: Vec<AssemblySocket>,
    #[serde(default = "default_collider_type")]
    pub collider_type: String,
}

fn default_collider_type() -> String {
    "convex".to_string()
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct CompiledAssembly {
    pub root_name: String,
    pub total_vertices: usize,
    pub total_triangles: usize,
    pub component_count: usize,
    pub sockets: Vec<String>,
    pub collider_node: String,
    pub manifest: blender_mcp_geom::GameAssetManifest,
}

pub fn compile_assembly_grammar(grammar: &AssemblyGrammar) -> CompiledAssembly {
    let mut total_vertices = 0;
    let mut total_triangles = 0;

    for comp in &grammar.components {
        match comp.component_type.as_str() {
            "barrel" => {
                let p = crate::props::synthesize_municipal_prop(&crate::props::PropSynthParams {
                    prop_type: crate::props::MunicipalPropType::WesternBarrel,
                    scale: comp.scale[0],
                    distress: 0.1,
                });
                total_vertices += p.mesh.vertex_count();
                total_triangles += p.mesh.triangle_count();
            }
            "crate" => {
                let p = crate::props::synthesize_municipal_prop(&crate::props::PropSynthParams {
                    prop_type: crate::props::MunicipalPropType::WoodenCrate,
                    scale: comp.scale[0],
                    distress: 0.0,
                });
                total_vertices += p.mesh.vertex_count();
                total_triangles += p.mesh.triangle_count();
            }
            _ => {
                total_vertices += 24;
                total_triangles += 12;
            }
        }
    }

    let socket_names: Vec<String> = grammar.sockets.iter().map(|s| s.name.clone()).collect();
    let prefix = if grammar.collider_type == "box" {
        "UBX_"
    } else if grammar.collider_type == "capsule" {
        "UCP_"
    } else {
        "UCX_"
    };
    let collider_node = format!("{}{}_01", prefix, grammar.root_name);

    let manifest = blender_mcp_geom::GameAssetManifest {
        name: grammar.root_name.clone(),
        version: "0.1.0".to_string(),
        triangle_count: total_triangles,
        vertex_count: total_vertices,
        material_slots: 1,
        dimensions: [1.0, 1.0, 1.0],
        colliders: vec![collider_node.clone()],
        sockets: socket_names.clone(),
        lod_levels: vec!["LOD0".to_string(), "LOD1".to_string()],
    };

    CompiledAssembly {
        root_name: grammar.root_name.clone(),
        total_vertices,
        total_triangles,
        component_count: grammar.components.len(),
        sockets: socket_names,
        collider_node,
        manifest,
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_compile_assembly_grammar() {
        let grammar = AssemblyGrammar {
            root_name: "Saloon_Entrance_Diorama".to_string(),
            components: vec![
                AssemblyComponent {
                    name: "Stave_Barrel".to_string(),
                    component_type: "barrel".to_string(),
                    position: [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
                    scale: [1.0, 1.0, 1.0],
                },
                AssemblyComponent {
                    name: "Ammo_Crate".to_string(),
                    component_type: "crate".to_string(),
                    position: [0.5, 0.0, 0.0],
                    scale: [0.5, 0.5, 0.5],
                },
            ],
            sockets: vec![
                AssemblySocket {
                    name: "SOCKET_hitch_ring".to_string(),
                    position: [0.0, 1.0, 0.0],
                    rotation: [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
                },
            ],
            collider_type: "convex".to_string(),
        };

        let compiled = compile_assembly_grammar(&grammar);
        assert_eq!(compiled.root_name, "Saloon_Entrance_Diorama");
        assert_eq!(compiled.component_count, 2);
        assert!(compiled.total_triangles > 100);
        assert_eq!(compiled.sockets, vec!["SOCKET_hitch_ring"]);
        assert_eq!(compiled.collider_node, "UCX_Saloon_Entrance_Diorama_01");
        assert_eq!(compiled.manifest.material_slots, 1);
    }
}

## CRATE FILE: crates/blender-mcp-synth/src/mesh.rs

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ProceduralMesh {
    pub name: String,
    pub vertices: Vec<[f32; 3]>,
    pub normals: Vec<[f32; 3]>,
    pub uvs: Vec<[f32; 2]>,
    pub indices: Vec<[u32; 3]>,
    pub material_name: String,
}

impl ProceduralMesh {
    pub fn new(name: impl Into<String>, material_name: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        Self {
            name: name.into(),
            vertices: Vec::new(),
            normals: Vec::new(),
            uvs: Vec::new(),
            indices: Vec::new(),
            material_name: material_name.into(),
        }
    }

    pub fn vertex_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.vertices.len()
    }

    pub fn triangle_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.indices.len()
    }

    pub fn bounds(&self) -> ([f32; 3], [f32; 3]) {
        let mut min = [f32::INFINITY; 3];
        let mut max = [f32::NEG_INFINITY; 3];

        for v in &self.vertices {
            for i in 0..3 {
                if v[i] < min[i] {
                    min[i] = v[i];
                }
                if v[i] > max[i] {
                    max[i] = v[i];
                }
            }
        }

        if self.vertices.is_empty() {
            ([0.0; 3], [0.0; 3])
        } else {
            (min, max)
        }
    }

    pub fn dimensions(&self) -> [f32; 3] {
        let (min, max) = self.bounds();
        [
            (max[0] - min[0]).abs(),
            (max[1] - min[1]).abs(),
            (max[2] - min[2]).abs(),
        ]
    }
}

## CRATE FILE: crates/blender-mcp-synth/src/props.rs

use std::f32::consts::PI;
use schemars::JsonSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use crate::mesh::ProceduralMesh;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum MunicipalPropType {
    WesternBarrel,
    WoodenCrate,
    HitchingPost,
    Lantern,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct PropSynthParams {
    pub prop_type: MunicipalPropType,
    #[serde(default = "default_scale")]
    pub scale: f32,
    #[serde(default = "default_distress")]
    pub distress: f32,
}

fn default_scale() -> f32 { 1.0 }
fn default_distress() -> f32 { 0.1 }

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct SynthesizedProp {
    pub prop_type: MunicipalPropType,
    pub mesh: ProceduralMesh,
    pub sockets: Vec<String>,
    pub collider_type: blender_mcp_geom::ColliderType,
}

pub fn synthesize_municipal_prop(params: &PropSynthParams) -> SynthesizedProp {
    match params.prop_type {
        MunicipalPropType::WesternBarrel => synthesize_barrel(params),
        MunicipalPropType::WoodenCrate => synthesize_crate(params),
        MunicipalPropType::HitchingPost => synthesize_hitching_post(params),
        MunicipalPropType::Lantern => synthesize_lantern(params),
    }
}

fn synthesize_barrel(params: &PropSynthParams) -> SynthesizedProp {
    let mut mesh = ProceduralMesh::new("Western_Barrel_Master", "M_Western_Wood");
    let staves = 16;
    let rings = 8;
    let height = 1.0 * params.scale;
    let base_radius = 0.38 * params.scale;
    let belly_radius = 0.46 * params.scale;

    for r in 0..=rings {
        let v = r as f32 / rings as f32;
        let y = (v - 0.5) * height;
        // Parabolic stave bulge (barrel curvature)
        let bulge = 1.0 - 4.0 * (v - 0.5) * (v - 0.5);
        let current_radius = base_radius + (belly_radius - base_radius) * bulge;

        for s in 0..staves {
            let u = s as f32 / staves as f32;
            let angle = u * 2.0 * PI;
            let x = angle.cos() * current_radius;
            let z = angle.sin() * current_radius;

            mesh.vertices.push([x, y, z]);
            mesh.normals.push([angle.cos(), 0.1 * (v - 0.5), angle.sin()]);
            mesh.uvs.push([u, v]);
        }
    }

    for r in 0..rings {
        for s in 0..staves {
            let next_s = (s + 1) % staves;
            let idx0 = r * staves + s;
            let idx1 = r * staves + next_s;
            let idx2 = (r + 1) * staves + next_s;
            let idx3 = (r + 1) * staves + s;

            mesh.indices.push([idx0 as u32, idx1 as u32, idx2 as u32]);
            mesh.indices.push([idx0 as u32, idx2 as u32, idx3 as u32]);
        }
    }

    SynthesizedProp {
        prop_type: MunicipalPropType::WesternBarrel,
        mesh,
        sockets: vec![
            "SOCKET_grip_primary".to_string(),
            "SOCKET_grip_secondary".to_string(),
            "SOCKET_bung_hole".to_string(),
        ],
        collider_type: blender_mcp_geom::ColliderType::Capsule,
    }
}

fn synthesize_crate(params: &PropSynthParams) -> SynthesizedProp {
    let mut mesh = ProceduralMesh::new("Frontier_Crate_Master", "M_Crate_Wood");
    let size = 0.8 * params.scale;
    let h = size * 0.5;

    let corners = [
        [-h, -h, -h], [h, -h, -h], [h, h, -h], [-h, h, -h],
        [-h, -h,  h], [h, -h,  h], [h, h,  h], [-h, h,  h],
    ];

    for c in &corners {
        mesh.vertices.push(*c);
        mesh.normals.push([c[0], c[1], c[2]]);
        mesh.uvs.push([c[0] + 0.5, c[1] + 0.5]);
    }

    let indices = [
        // Front
        [0, 1, 2], [0, 2, 3],
        // Back
        [5, 4, 7], [5, 7, 6],
        // Top
        [3, 2, 6], [3, 6, 7],
        // Bottom
        [4, 5, 1], [4, 1, 0],
        // Right
        [1, 5, 6], [1, 6, 2],
        // Left
        [4, 0, 3], [4, 3, 7],
    ];
    mesh.indices.extend_from_slice(&indices);

    SynthesizedProp {
        prop_type: MunicipalPropType::WoodenCrate,
        mesh,
        sockets: vec![
            "SOCKET_mount_top".to_string(),
            "SOCKET_ground".to_string(),
        ],
        collider_type: blender_mcp_geom::ColliderType::Box,
    }
}

fn synthesize_hitching_post(params: &PropSynthParams) -> SynthesizedProp {
    let mut mesh = ProceduralMesh::new("Saloon_Hitching_Post", "M_Weathered_Wood");
    let h = 1.2 * params.scale;
    let r = 0.12 * params.scale;
    let segments = 8;

    for y_step in [0.0, h] {
        for s in 0..segments {
            let u = s as f32 / segments as f32;
            let angle = u * 2.0 * PI;
            let x = angle.cos() * r;
            let z = angle.sin() * r;
            mesh.vertices.push([x, y_step, z]);
            mesh.normals.push([angle.cos(), 0.0, angle.sin()]);
            mesh.uvs.push([u, y_step / h]);
        }
    }

    for s in 0..segments {
        let next_s = (s + 1) % segments;
        let idx0 = s;
        let idx1 = next_s;
        let idx2 = segments + next_s;
        let idx3 = segments + s;
        mesh.indices.push([idx0 as u32, idx1 as u32, idx2 as u32]);
        mesh.indices.push([idx0 as u32, idx2 as u32, idx3 as u32]);
    }

    SynthesizedProp {
        prop_type: MunicipalPropType::HitchingPost,
        mesh,
        sockets: vec![
            "SOCKET_hitch_ring".to_string(),
            "SOCKET_ground".to_string(),
        ],
        collider_type: blender_mcp_geom::ColliderType::Capsule,
    }
}

fn synthesize_lantern(params: &PropSynthParams) -> SynthesizedProp {
    let mut mesh = ProceduralMesh::new("Kerosene_Lantern", "M_Lantern_Metal");
    let h = 0.45 * params.scale;
    let r = 0.14 * params.scale;
    let segments = 12;

    for y_step in [0.0, h * 0.3, h * 0.7, h] {
        for s in 0..segments {
            let u = s as f32 / segments as f32;
            let angle = u * 2.0 * PI;
            let current_r = if y_step > h * 0.3 && y_step < h * 0.7 { r * 1.2 } else { r };
            mesh.vertices.push([angle.cos() * current_r, y_step, angle.sin() * current_r]);
            mesh.normals.push([angle.cos(), 0.0, angle.sin()]);
            mesh.uvs.push([u, y_step / h]);
        }
    }

    SynthesizedProp {
        prop_type: MunicipalPropType::Lantern,
        mesh,
        sockets: vec![
            "SOCKET_grip_handle".to_string(),
            "SOCKET_fx_light".to_string(),
            "SOCKET_fx_smoke".to_string(),
        ],
        collider_type: blender_mcp_geom::ColliderType::Convex,
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_barrel_synthesis() {
        let params = PropSynthParams {
            prop_type: MunicipalPropType::WesternBarrel,
            scale: 1.0,
            distress: 0.1,
        };
        let prop = synthesize_municipal_prop(&params);
        assert_eq!(prop.prop_type, MunicipalPropType::WesternBarrel);
        assert!(prop.mesh.triangle_count() > 100);
        assert!(prop.sockets.contains(&"SOCKET_grip_primary".to_string()));
        assert_eq!(prop.collider_type, blender_mcp_geom::ColliderType::Capsule);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_crate_synthesis() {
        let params = PropSynthParams {
            prop_type: MunicipalPropType::WoodenCrate,
            scale: 1.0,
            distress: 0.0,
        };
        let prop = synthesize_municipal_prop(&params);
        assert_eq!(prop.collider_type, blender_mcp_geom::ColliderType::Box);
        assert_eq!(prop.mesh.triangle_count(), 12);
    }
}
